result: Continuation: no code change; the first run's red was a gate job that was never started. Clippy, so and static pass on the inherited head; gate, plants and the dynamic subset rerun on keke under jobrun
informational: Cause of the first run's red: its hand-back named dl-libc-nonshared-gate-2, which was never started on mei; its gate-3 attempt left a log but no jobs.tsv row, so it did not finish under jobrun. Not a code fault.

cargo xtask affected escalates this branch to FULL: csys/nonshared/*.c (csys/ C sources are not mapped to a tier) and xtask/src/so.rs. A mapping of csys/nonshared/ and of xtask so.rs's nonshared step to the products tests (s01_startup_symbols, conformance_dynamic) would make the direct tier enough.

Carried from DL-LIBC-NONSHARED: Liella's __cxa_finalize(dso) does not drop atfork handlers registered with dso (not reachable until the loader has dlclose); the dynamic subset still uses the host's start files; libc_nonshared.a and libc.so are not in remap::PRODUCTS.

impact.what: programs and shared objects link against an installed Liella with no host libc_nonshared.a (owner ruling #4807); carried from DL-LIBC-NONSHARED, this run proves it
tests carried from DL-LIBC-NONSHARED: s1_2_c_5_nonshared_archive_two_way and the link-map check in the dynamic subset; 3 plants

improvement: handback-check could refuse a JOBS label with no jobs.tsv row before the hand-back is sent (the first run sent one), and the affected map could cover csys/nonshared/ so this change gates on the direct tier instead of FULL.
next_step: DL-ATFORK-FINALIZE: give atfork entries a module slot and drop them in __cxa_finalize(dso), before phase 14's dlclose.
